title: Grief Counseling
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office grapples with the death of Ed Truck. Michael announces Ed's passing and considers how to honor him, while attempting to lead a grief counseling session that faces challenges from reluctant coworkers. The episode explores themes of grief, emotional expression, and office dynamics as characters share memories, organize a funeral for a bird, and confront their feelings about loss.

main_threads.thread: Office's response to Ed Truck's death and grief management

evidence.snippet: Michael: Attention, everybody. I just received a call from corporate with some news they felt that I should know first. My old boss Ed Truck has died.
Michael: Well, we are talking about how to properly honor a man who gave his life as regional manager of this company, Jan.
Michael: I think that is a great way to honor Ed.
Creed: Ed was decapitated.
Creed: He was drunk as a skunk, he was flying down Route 6. He slides under an 18 wheeler. Pop. It snaps right off.
Michael: There are five stages to grief, which are denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance.
